releaseNotesMarkdown:
### cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg (ghcr.io/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg)

### [`v1.30.2`](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/releases/tag/v1.30.2)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/compare/v1.30.1...v1.30.2)

**Release date:** Nov 17, 2026

##### Important changes

- **PostgreSQL 18.7 is the new default image**: the default operand image is now `18.7-system-trixie`, which fixes several CVEs. It applies only to new clusters that don't set an image. To get the fixes, update existing clusters to 18.7, 17.12, 16.16 or 15.20 by changing `imageName` or the `ImageCatalog`. Before updating, read the [PostgreSQL 18.7 announcement](https://www.postgresql.org/about/news/postgresql-187-1712-1616-1520-1425-and-19-rc-2-released-3442/) and the release notes it links. ([#​11833](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11833)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- **PostgreSQL 14 is no longer supported**: the PostgreSQL community stopped fixing PostgreSQL 14 on November 12, 2026, and CloudNativePG supports a major version only as long as PostgreSQL does. If you still run PostgreSQL 14, plan an upgrade to a newer major version. PostgreSQL 15 stops receiving fixes on November 11, 2027. ([#​11935](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11935)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- The operator now needs the `delete` permission on `leases`. Users who manage the RBAC manually must add it. ([#​11609](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11609))

##### Enhancements

- **Streaming retry for standbys on the WAL archive**: PostgreSQL tries streaming only after a restore from the archive fails. If WAL is produced about as fast as it is restored, that may never happen, and the standby stays on the archive, with no WAL receiver and no part in synchronous replication. Now, after 30 seconds of continuous restores, WAL restore fails on purpose for 5 seconds, so PostgreSQL tries streaming. These failures are expected and can appear in the logs. ([#​11868](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11868)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- **Server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C)**: added `sseCustomerKey` in `s3Credentials`, to use SSE-C with S3-compatible object stores. It works with backups, WAL archiving and recovery. ([#​11711](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11711), <!-- 1.28 --> [#​11775](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11775)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- `Backup` and `ScheduledBackup` resources that use the `barmanObjectStore` method now return an admission warning about the removal of native Barman Cloud support in 1.32, as `Cluster` resources already did. ([#​11725](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11725)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- `extension_control_path` and `dynamic_library_path` no longer list directories that are missing from an extension image, for example `share` in an image that ships only `lib`. ([#​11652](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11652))

- Transient network errors from `barman-cloud-wal-restore` are now logged (needs Barman 3.20.0 or later). ([#​11541](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11541)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- Moved the "Defaulting for ..." operator log lines from info to debug level. They were printed at every reconciliation and hid other messages. ([#​11790](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11790)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- `cnpg` plugin:

  - `kubectl cnpg status` no longer fails without the `pods/exec` permission. It shows `not permitted: requires the pods/exec permission` instead of the size and configuration sections. ([#​11687](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11687)) <!-- 1.28 -->

##### Security and Supply Chain

- Updated `golang.org/x/net` to v0.62.0, fixing GO-2026-6617, GO-2026-6612, GO-2026-6611, GO-2026-6610, GO-2026-6603, GO-2026-6860 and GO-2026-6866, and bumped the other `golang.org/x` modules. ([#​11631](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11631), <!-- 1.28 --> [#​11867](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11867)) <!-- 1.28 -->

##### Changes

- Updated the default PgBouncer image from 1.25.2 to 1.26.1. Poolers that use the default image roll out the new version when the operator is upgraded. ([#​11571](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11571), <!-- 1.28 --> [#​11704](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11704)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- Updated the `barman-cloud` library to v0.7.0, which skips failed backups when it reads the backup catalog. ([#​11711](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11711)) <!-- 1.28 -->

##### Fixes

- Fixed enabling a sidecar plugin on a running cluster. Pods created before that have no sidecar until they are recreated. They logged `Unknown plugin` errors, their metrics scrapes failed, and a switchover could wait forever. When the plugin archives WAL, the former primary crash looped until the Pod was deleted. The operator now recreates it. ([#​11858](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11858)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- Fixed replicas created from an online volume snapshot ignoring the `backup_label` and `tablespace_map` stored in the snapshot. PostgreSQL did crash recovery and did not fetch WAL from the archive. ([#​11847](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11847)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- Fixed logical decoding stalling while a new replica was bootstrapping, with `synchronizeLogicalDecoding` enabled. The replica is now left out of `synchronized_standby_slots` (or `pg_failover_slots.standby_slot_names`) until its volume is initialized. ([#​11802](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11802)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- Fixed `status.phaseReason` being cleared and set again several times a second while a cluster was being created or changed, for example "Some instances are not yet active". This loaded the API server and made `kubectl get cluster -w` noisy. ([#​11789](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11789))

- Fixed the operator retrying instance status requests that failed with an error response, as if the failure was a network error. During a switchover the old primary answers with an error while PostgreSQL is stopped, so each reconciliation waited about 1.6 seconds, which slowed the whole switchover. Contributed by [@​kabbydriver](https://redirect.github.com/kabbydriver). ([#​11793](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11793)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- Fixed the WAL count and size metrics counting `.partial`, `.backup` and `.history` files. ([#​9967](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/9967)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- Fixed replicas crash looping with `recovery aborted because of insufficient parameter settings` after a hot standby parameter such as `max_connections` was removed from `.spec.postgresql.parameters`. Contributed by [@​ichibahn](https://redirect.github.com/ichibahn). ([#​11236](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11236)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- Fixed the instance manager waiting forever on a frozen postmaster, one that accepts connections but never answers. This blocked the instance status, the metrics exporter and the check before an in-tree backup. Local connection attempts to PostgreSQL now time out after 5 seconds. ([#​11718](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11718)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- Fixed a `Cluster` recreated over leftover resources (for example by a backup tool) staying in `Unable to create required cluster objects` with `cannot set an ownerRef on a resource you can't delete`. This happened with the `OwnerReferencesPermissionEnforcement` admission plugin. When restoring over orphan PVCs, the operator now deletes the stale primary `Lease`, so the new primary does not wait for it to expire. ([#​11609](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11609))

- Fixed WAL restore reporting the end of the WAL archive on the wrong timeline. A replica restored from a snapshot could miss valid WAL of the new timeline and replay WAL of the parent timeline instead. Contributed by [@​ardentperf](https://redirect.github.com/ardentperf). ([#​11133](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11133)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- Fixed a `Cluster` not being reconciled again when a plugin asked for a retry without a delay. For example, a `Cluster` created before the `ObjectStore` of the Barman Cloud plugin stayed in `BootstrapPending`. The operator now retries after one second. Contributed by [@​valeriodelsarto](https://redirect.github.com/valeriodelsarto). ([#​11683](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11683)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- Fixed `ConsistentSystemID` turning `False` while PostgreSQL is not running, for example in replica clusters after a demotion, or on fenced instances. The system ID is now read from disk, so it no longer needs a running PostgreSQL. ([#​11645](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11645)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- Fixed a `Backup` that could be started more than once, or moved back to `pending` after it started. ([#​11617](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11617)) <!-- 1.28 -->

- `cnpg` plugin:

  - Fixed `kubectl cnpg backup` for volume snapshot backups: when only one of `--immediate-checkpoint` and `--wait-for-archive` was set, the other option used its default instead of the value in `.spec.backup.volumeSnapshot.onlineConfiguration`. ([#​11733](https://redirect.github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pull/11733)) <!-- 1.28 -->
